verdict.rationale: Latham & Watkins handles client data and runs digital tools (the LathamDrive document generator and the Book of Jargon apps), so whether user data can be kept out of AI model training is a fair privacy question. However, the evidence pack contains no AI-training opt-out, data-use policy, or similar control. The Privacy & Cyber page describes the firm's legal advisory practice for clients, not the firm's own handling of user data, so it does not count here.
